column2: Building the Supply Chain of the Future
Intel has one of the world’s most complex, technologically advanced supply chains. We hold the many
suppliers with whom we do business accountable for operating with the same high standards that we
expect of ourselves. We communicate our expectations clearly, work to identify and address issues at
the system level, and share our findings and best practices across the industry. Through accountability
and transparency, we are raising the social and environmental performance bar for companies around
the globe and building the supply chain of the future.
